description: Returns individual requests AI crawlers and agents made to this site — the discovery endpoints (llms.txt, the .md twins, JSON-LD, sitemaps) and, unless the owner turned that stream off, ordinary pages too, which arrive under the endpoint label "page" (one label for every URL, as "markdown" is one label for every .md twin). Newest first and cursor-paginated. Each row has the endpoint, the detected agent, its user-agent, the owning network, and a verdict (0=unchecked, 1=verified real engine, 2=spoofed impersonator). Filter by agent, endpoint, network, verdict, signer, or a user-agent prefix. To answer "has any AI signed its requests to this site?", pass signer="*" — the rows that come back are the ones that carried a cryptographic signature, and none coming back is a real answer, not a missing feature.

agent.description: Exact detected agent name, or a list of them (OR-ed).

before.description: Pagination cursor: return rows with id below this (use the previous page’s "cursor").

endpoint.description: Exact endpoint path, or a list of them (OR-ed).

group.description: "visits" returns `visits` instead of `rows`: each visitor's requests (same agent, network and user-agent) grouped while no more than gapSeconds pass between them, newest first. A visit of several pages in seconds is what an assistant answering a question looks like; one page at a time is a crawl. The log keeps no IP addresses, so two people using the same assistant at once from one network share a visit. per_page then counts visits; page with "before" = the previous "cursor". "pages" returns `pages` instead: one line per post/page with traffic in the date range, busiest first — bot reads, readers from AI, the busiest bots, last read — the same counts read-post-traffic gives; only from/to apply, and `unattributed` counts reads of archives and other addresses that are not one post. Default "rows".

network.description: Exact owning network, or a list of them (OR-ed). Only populated when "identify every bot" is on.

per_page.description: Rows per page (the store clamps this).

post.description: Only reads of this post/page and its Markdown copy — the rows read-post-traffic counts as its bot reads (plus refused and fake ones, which carry their status).

signer.description: Web Bot Auth. Exact signer, or a list of them (OR-ed) — and the wildcard "*" meaning "carried a cryptographic signature at all", which is how you ask whether ANYTHING has signed to this site yet (you cannot name an operator you have never seen). Mixing "*" with exact names is allowed and reads as it looks.

verdict.description: 0 = unchecked, 1 = verified real engine, 2 = spoofed impersonator, or "refused" = turned away at the door and never served. One value or a list (OR-ed). ⚠️ "refused" is an OUTCOME, not a verdict, and lives in its own column — mixing it with a verdict in one list is allowed and means exactly what it reads like.

name: agentimus-read-request-log

from.description: With group "pages": first day counted, Y-m-d (GMT).

gapSeconds.description: Silence, in seconds, that ends a visit.

group.description: Which view this is, when not rows.

identifyOn.description: Whether "identify every bot" (network attribution) is on.

knownSince.description: With group "pages": when not empty, the first day reads can be placed on a page at all.

matching.description: With group "pages": TRUE while older traffic is still being matched to its posts — the numbers may rise.

noAddress.description: With group "pages": page reads logged before the log recorded which page was read — they belong to no line.

offset.description: Rows skipped before this page. Always 0 in the default (newest-first) order, which pages by cursor instead.

pageTotal.description: With group "pages": how many posts/pages had traffic in the range.

pageViewsOn.description: Whether visits to ORDINARY PAGES are recorded (endpoint "page"), or only the generated agent files. False means the absence of page rows says nothing about whether crawlers read the content — the question was never asked.

pages.description: With group "pages": one line per post/page, busiest first.

botKinds.description: How many different bots read it.

bots.description: Bot reads of the page and its Markdown copy (refused, proven fakes, scripts and WordPress sites left out).

last.description: Its last bot read, GMT; empty when only readers from AI came.

path.description: For endpoint "page": which page was read, as a site-relative address ("/my-post/", or "/?p=12" on plain permalinks). Empty for every other endpoint, whose label is already its address, and for page rows recorded before Agentimus 1.51.7.

refused.description: True = turned away at the door, never served.

signer.description: Web Bot Auth: who the signature proves (verdict 1), who signed validly but is not an operator this site recognises, so it earned no standing (verdict 0), or who a failed signature claimed to be (verdict 2). Empty when no signature was involved and the verdict came from DNS/ranges or nothing.

title.description: What the site calls that page: the post title, "Homepage", "Tag: x", or the path itself when nothing on the site matches it any more. Empty when path is empty.

by.description: Which column the rows are ordered by: at, client, endpoint, ua or status.

to.description: With group "pages": last day counted, Y-m-d (GMT).

unattributed.description: With group "pages": bot reads of addresses that are not one post (archives, tag pages, the blog index, Markdown copies read before reads named their post).

verifyOn.description: Whether Web Bot Auth signature verification is on.

visitTotal.description: With group "visits": how many visits match the filters, across every page.

count.description: Requests in the visit (after the filters).

partial.description: True when the read stopped inside this visit, so it may continue on the next page.

rows.description: The visit's requests, newest first; at most 50, the rest are counted in "count".

title: Get the AI request log
